description: Multimodal sensor dataset from vehicle-mounted mobile mapping system for comprehensive urban scenes is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Shengyu Lu et al. Mobile mapping is the research trend in the mapping field due to its superior time efficiency compared to traditional fixed mapping methods. It is an important digital base for numerous applications, such as high-definition (HD) maps, digital twins, smart cities. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: Image. The only repository address found in the article is the code repository in GitHub named in its Code Availability section; the data may be hosted elsewhere, as the Data Records section of the article states. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
